title: Signed distance from the origin
statement: For an integer $p$ and Boolean $side$, suppose $p\ge 0$ if $side$ is true and $p\le 0$ if $side$ is false. Then $p=(1\text{ if }side\text{ is true, and }-1\text{ otherwise})\,|p|$, where $|p|$ is the absolute value of the integer.
